headlines.title: Trump holds historic meeting with Xi and Putin
headlines.description: President Trump took part in historic three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping in China. NBC News' Garrett Haake has the details.

headlines.title: Trump urges nuclear arms control in historic meeting with Putin and Xi
headlines.description: What these three men might decide has the potential to reverberate across the globe.

headlines.title: Classified NSA network is still down, leaving some staff working from home
headlines.description: The network went down on Tuesday due to a technical problem during maintenance operations, but sources say it has not affected its work collecting electronic intelligence.

headlines.title: Palestinians flee as Israeli tanks cross Gaza ceasefire’s ‘yellow line’
headlines.description: Israel’s ground operation across the yellow ceasefire line in Gaza, which forced Palestinians to flee their makeshift shelters, marks a fresh escalation in the conflict and risks undermining an already floundering truce with Hamas, analysts said Thursday.

headlines.title: Former rocket scientist becomes NFL defensive coach
headlines.description: Chenzo Funari decided to quit his job as a rocket scientist at SpaceX to pursue his passion for football. Now, he’s an NFL Defensive Backs Coach for the Minnesota Vikings. NBC News’ Sam Brock caught up with Funari to talk about his journey from space to the gridiron.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Fiona the hippo dies after eating hat, Cincinnati Zoo says
headlines.description: Cincinnati Zoo’s beloved hippo Fiona has died following complications from eating a hat that was tossed by a visitor and ended up in her enclosure, the zoo announced Thursday.

headlines.title: My boss canceled our 1:1 so I could keep playing ‘GTA’
headlines.description: Within the first 20 minutes of playing “GTA 6,” I’ve been Tased, driven a boat, ransacked a remote drug dealer’s compound, stolen their cash and made my getaway in a plane.

headlines.description: Veteran actor Larry Poindexter — who appeared in soap operas “Days of Our Lives” and “General Hospital” and the movie “S.W.A.T.”

headlines.description: This NFL season was supposed to be a celebration for ESPN, as it prepares to host its first Super Bowl.

headlines.title: Jax Taylor, former ‘Vanderpump Rules’ and Bravo reality TV star, reveals cancer diagnosis
headlines.description: Jax Taylor, who was made famous on the Bravo reality series “Vanderpump Rules,” shared with fans Thursday that he was recently diagnosed with cancer.
